marketing_description: The Philips LED Bulb, part number 564385, offers 450 lumens of warm white light with a color temperature of 2700 K and a color rendering index of 90. This 4.4 W bulb is a dimmable option with a medium E26 base and is equivalent to a 40 W incandescent bulb. It has an average life of 15000 hours and is Title 20 Compliant.
